questions.q: Which interface table does the Journal Import FBDI template stage data into?
options: AP_INVOICES_INTERFACE
GL_INTERFACE
RA_INTERFACE_LINES_ALL
FA_MASS_ADDITIONS
questions.explain: GL_INTERFACE is the General Ledger's staging table, where journal rows land before the Import Journals process validates and creates real entries.

questions.q: What rule does General Ledger enforce for a journal batch, without exception?
options: Every journal must use exactly one account segment
Every journal line must be under $1,000
Total debits must equal total credits for the batch
All journal entries must use the same currency as the prior year
questions.explain: This is the accounting equation in practice: a journal batch must balance, with debits equal to credits, or it is rejected as a group.

questions.q: Why can a batch of journal lines be rejected even if every individual line's account combination and amount format look correct?
options: Because the balancing rule (debits = credits) is validated at the batch level, not just row by row
Because journals can never be imported via FBDI
Because General Ledger ignores all validation
Because only one journal line is allowed per batch
questions.explain: Some validations, like batch balancing, operate above the level of any single row — a batch can fail even when every individual line looks fine on its own.

questions.q: What does the 'Import Journals' process actually do once rows are staged in GL_INTERFACE?
options: It deletes the staged rows without processing them
It uploads the file to UCM
It only generates a CSV file
It validates account combinations and batch balance, and creates real, postable journal entries for rows that pass
questions.explain: Import Journals (via its child program) is the process that actually validates staged rows against the chart of accounts and balancing rules, then creates live journal entries.

questions.q: Which of these is a realistic, specific cause of a rejected journal row?
options: The file was named with lowercase letters
An account combination that was never set up or has been disabled in the chart of accounts
The spreadsheet used Arial instead of Calibri font
The journal was imported on a Tuesday
questions.explain: An invalid or disabled account combination is a genuine, common business-rule rejection reason for journal import rows.
